svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 501 mm of 8 mm stainless bar, ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Centre-drill each end in a drill press with the bar held

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: upright in a V-block; drill 5.0 mm 15 deep and tap M6.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screw an M6 x 20 stud into each end with medium threadlocker,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one end into the coupling nut on the sensor's plunger; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: other into the downslope rod-end ball joint on its stud.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set the plunger 15 mm out of the sensor body before tightening,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the gauge can read 85 mm of opening and 15 mm of closing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 501 mm long within 1 mm; straight within 1 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: when rolled on a flat bench.
